title: Spartathlon 2026 official GPX
claims: The 2026 GPX contains 4,830 track points and measures 244.045 km by haversine distance between consecutive points.
The GPX starts at 37.9701939, 23.7227698 at the Acropolis and ends at 37.0791005, 22.428455 at Sparta.
The GPX creator field is 'AspasiaGPT'; the file has no metadata block and no copyright or licence declaration.
The GPX is 246,320 bytes and contains no elevation values, so it cannot be used to verify a total climb.

verification.note: Official GPX downloaded from the route page and measured with a local haversine script.
